facts.fact: Orange Tunisie inaugurated its Kalaa Kebira (Sousse) data centre, 1,000 sqm, serving Orange's own needs and customers with hosting, cloud computing and backup.
facts.system: Orange Tunisie Kalaa Kebira data centre

facts.fact: Orange Tunisie describes its Kalaa Kebira data centre as Tier III (operator statement, no certification named).
